title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 124 (Contract of indemnity defined)

content.overview: Section 124 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 is headed "Contract of indemnity defined". This catalog record identifies the provision. The enacted text, amendment status and any case law must be checked against the official India Code text before reliance.

examples.title: Application of s-124
examples.body: Facts that satisfy the elements stated in the provision produce the consequence described in the text.

hypotheticals.question: Do the facts engage s-124?

distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the statutory text.
